mutants.why: resolveDownloadUrl now returns the checksum URL instead of the ISO URL (fetch the wrong file). testResolveDownloadUrl asserts QVERIFY(url.contains(ubuntu.version)); ubuntu-desktop's checksumUrl 'https://releases.ubuntu.com/resolute/SHA256SUMS' contains no '26.04', so the assert fails.

the {version} placeholder is filled from versionLabel ('Resolute Raccoon (LTS)') instead of version ('26.04'). testResolveDownloadUrl QVERIFY(url.contains(ubuntu.version)) fails because the URL no longer contains '26.04'.
resolveDownloadUrl yields an empty URL (fail-open on the DirectURL path). testResolveDownloadUrl QVERIFY(!url.isEmpty()) fails.

substituteVersion searches for the non-existent token '{versionX}', so the real '{version}' placeholder is left un-substituted in every template. testResolveDownloadUrl QVERIFY(!url.contains("{version}")) fails (and QVERIFY(url.contains(ubuntu.version)) also fails).
the {version} placeholder is replaced by an empty string instead of the real version, so the resolved URL loses '26.04'. testResolveDownloadUrl QVERIFY(url.contains(ubuntu.version)) fails.

inverting the fail-closed empty-checksum guard makes a distro that HAS a checksum URL take the empty-return branch. ubuntu-desktop's checksumUrl is non-empty, so testResolveChecksumUrl (which asserts QVERIFY(!url.isEmpty()) when checksumUrl is non-empty) fails.
resolveFileName now yields '...-amd64.img'. testResolveFileName QVERIFY(name.endsWith(".iso")) fails.

resolveChecksumUrl now returns the ISO download URL, so a later verify would fetch its 'expected' digest from the ISO URL rather than SHA256SUMS (integrity break). testResolveChecksumUrl now asserts QCOMPARE(url, ubuntu.checksumUrl) and QCOMPARE(url, 'https://releases.ubuntu.com/resolute/SHA256SUMS') AND QVERIFY(url != resolveDownloadUrl(ubuntu)); the mutant makes url == the ISO download URL, so every one of those turns red.

resolveFileName yields a wrong filename ('...-server-amd64.iso') that a checksum-by-filename lookup would never match. testResolveFileName now asserts QCOMPARE(name, "ubuntu-" + ubuntu.version + "-desktop-amd64.iso") -- the whole filename, every segment -- so the mutated middle segment '-server-' turns it red even though it still ends in ".iso" and carries no "{version}".

GitHubRelease branch of resolveDownloadUrl (cached-asset lookup): the mutant changes the find key from distro.id to distro.id + "_x". testResolveGitHubReleaseCachedAsset seeds m_githubAssetUrls[ventoy.id] directly -- with no network, via the friend-class test seam (friend class TestLinuxDistroCatalog on LinuxDistroCatalog) -- with the exact asset URL a successful resolveGitHubAsset would cache ('https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/releases/download/v1.1.12/ventoy-1.1.12-livecd.iso'), then asserts QCOMPARE(resolveDownloadUrl(ventoy), that URL). The real code finds distro.id and returns the cached URL; the mutant looks up distro.id + "_x" -> cache miss -> {}, so the QCOMPARE turns red. Killed offline. grep -Fc of the find string in src/core/linux_distro_catalog.cpp == 1 (line 504).

resolveFileName's GitHubRelease branch: inverting the static-template guard makes a GitHubRelease distro that HAS a filename template (ventoy: 'ventoy-{version}-livecd.iso') skip it and fall to the fail-closed 'return {}'. testResolveGitHubReleaseBranch asserts QCOMPARE(resolveFileName(ventoy), "ventoy-" + ventoy.version + "-livecd.iso") == 'ventoy-1.1.12-livecd.iso', which turns red when the branch returns empty. grep -Fc of the find string in src/core/linux_distro_catalog.cpp == 1 (line 541).
